plain_english: In calm, calm; in glad, glad — so the fool is deluded; amid principles, the Lord is truly not so.
sanskrit_cite: śānte śānta ivāyaṃ hṛṣṭe hṛṣṭo vimohavati mūḍhaḥ | tattvagaṇe sati bhagavān na punaḥ paramārthataḥ sa tathā

plain_english: First removing the shining of that-form in non-self, the supreme self shatters delusion of the non-self-form in self.
sanskrit_cite: yad anātmany api tadrūpāvabhāsanaṃ tat purā nirākṛtya | ātmany anātmarūpāṃ bhrāntiṃ vidalayati paramātmā

plain_english: Thus, for one whose goal is gained in cutting delusion-pair at the root, no weighing of other duties ever, for the supreme yogin.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ vibhramayugalakasamūlavicchedane kṛtārthasya | kartavyāntarakalanā na jātu parayogino bhavati

plain_english: Earth, nature, Māyā — this triad, fallen into known-form — by nondual-contemplation power becomes mere-being remainder.
sanskrit_cite: pṛthivī prakṛtir māyā tritayam idaṃ vedyarūpatāpatitam | advaitabhāvanabalād bhavati hi sanmātrapariśeṣam

plain_english: As girdle, earring, bracelet are seen as gold by leaving difference, so in leaving difference all shines as mere being.
sanskrit_cite: raśanāku.ṅdalakaṭakaṃ bhedatyāgena dṛśyate yathā hema | tadvad bhedatyāge sanmātraṃ sarvam ābhāti

plain_english: That brahman — supreme, pure, peaceful, nondual-natured, even, whole, deathless, true — rests in shining-formed power.
sanskrit_cite: tad brahma paraṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ abhedātmakaṃ samaṃ sakalam | amṛtaṃ satyaṃ śaktau viśrāmyati bhāsvarūpāyām

plain_english: Desired, known, done — by the shining-formed: untouched, yet it takes sky-flower-ness.
sanskrit_cite: iṣyata iti vedyata iti saṃpādyata iti ca bhāsvarūpeṇa | aparāmṛṣṭaṃ yad api tu nabhaḥprasūnatvam abhyeti

plain_english: By grasp-yoga of power's trident, the whole, in the supreme Lord, in Śiva-name, in supreme truth, is emitted by god of gods.
sanskrit_cite: śaktitriśūlaparigamayogena samastam api parameśe | śivanāmani paramārthe visṛjyate devadevena

plain_english: Again too, by five-power-spreading order, outside, that varied egg-three created by outer-self-gaining.
sanskrit_cite: punar api ca pañcaśaktiprasaraṇakrameṇa bahir api tat | a.ṅdatrayaṃ vicitraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ bahirātmalābhena
